title: Church Family Action Sort
purpose: Support the primary activity for The First Church Shares and Prays.
body_markdown:
# Church Family Action Sort

Use Acts 2:42-47; 4:32-35 as your evidence.

1. Write or draw three direct observations.
2. Mark one interpretation or conclusion.
3. Name one careful response.
4. Put a question mark beside anything the passage does not settle by itself.
